handoff_instructions: Fixed the failing acceptance check: attempt 1 put the M3 acceptance test at packages/core/test/m3-acceptance.test.ts, but the fixed acceptance command runs `vitest run test/acceptance-m3` inside @backoffice/workflows, so no test file matched and the check failed with 'No test files found'. Moved the same test (unchanged assertions) to packages/workflows/test/acceptance-m3.test.ts, matching the pattern already used by that package's other acceptance tests (test/acceptance/*.test.ts, test/field-capture-sms.test.ts): import domain services (createEmployee, createJob, runFieldCaptureWorkflow, listPendingApprovals, listOpenBillableOpportunities, listOrgOpsCases) from "@backoffice/core" instead of a relative "../src", and reuse @backoffice/core's test helpers (createWorld, count, inOrg, seedCommunicationId) via the same relative path other workflows tests already use ("../../core/test/helpers/..."). Deleted the old core-package copy so there is exactly one acceptance test. All checks pass locally: format:check, lint, typecheck, pnpm test (incl. production build + secret scan), test:tz, and the exact acceptance command `pnpm --filter @backoffice/workflows exec vitest run test/acceptance-m3`. Nothing left to do for this task; ready for review.
